# WO-108: Quieter, reliable checksum status announcements (CP-11)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-designer
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel)
Assigned to: Codex channel session (Nora dispatches)
Source: docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md CP-11 (accepted 2026-11-08; React was removed, so the target is now CopyHash.astro)

## Goal
Per CP-11: keep visible pending feedback but stop repeated polite announcements, and have a stable status region in the page before any terminal message (no-clipboard, failed, copied), so screen readers announce it. Keep the no-JS fallback (button hidden, code selectable) and the existing states. The component is now web/src/components/CopyHash.astro (plain module script, script-src 'self' on /download/ only).

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Built-site tests use the `test_web_` prefix (CI runs them in pages.yml), offline, no network, no new dependencies.
- `pnpm build`, `pnpm check`, content_check and ruff pass; existing tests stay green.
- Report product defects found; don't fix product files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- web/src/components/CopyHash.astro
- tests/test_web_copy_hash.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
CSP, build config, dependencies, release.yaml/site data, workflows, FaqList/FAQ copy, the home markup.

## Check-in plan
Report in docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md when done.
